transcript: Long one. Spent like eleven hours in the library cramming for the organic chem final. Green desk lamps, huge windows, and it started snowing outside around four. Jake brought me hot chocolate. Pretty sure I memorized every reaction. Walked home through the snow at midnight and it was dead quiet.

spec.moment: Walking home through the quiet snow at midnight after cramming in the library.

spec.scene: A narrow stone sidewalk dusted with powdery white snow stretches from front to back. In the center, a small bundled figure in a dark navy coat and grey scarf walks forward, holding a steaming takeaway cup in mittened hands. Small footprints trail behind them in the fresh snow. To the left, a tall dark iron lamppost glows with soft amber light, illuminating the ground. At the back edge sits the dark brick fragment of a sleeping townhouse with snowy steps.
spec.title: Snow at Midnight
spec.caption: Walked home in the dead quiet after eleven hours of chemistry.
